init.title: Home Maintenance Manager
init.description: Manage maintenance tasks, add custom tasks, or register household equipment.

configure_notifications.title: Maintenance notifications
configure_notifications.description: Choose whether to receive individual task reminders, a daily maintenance summary, or both. The next step will show only the settings needed for your choices.

manage_tasks.title: Maintenance task selection
manage_tasks.description: Select tasks by expanding a category. Use Select all or Clear all at the top, then finish to configure intervals.

intervals.title: Maintenance intervals
intervals.description: Set the interval in days for each selected recurring task. Seasonal tasks use their season windows instead.

add_custom_task.title: Add a custom maintenance task
add_custom_task.description: Start with the task name, category, and a short description. Choose an existing category or create a reusable new one.

add_equipment.title: Register household equipment
add_equipment.description: Start with the equipment name, category, icon, and Home Assistant area.

create_area.title: Create a Home Assistant area
create_area.description: Create an area that can be assigned to household equipment.

manage_equipment.description: Choose the equipment record you want to edit or remove.

equipment_actions.description: Edit the selected equipment record or remove it.
